slides.heading: Get it checked if you notice

caption:
Stiff swing and a sore lower back after 18 holes? Koko's story says look a little higher up ⛳

A smooth golf swing shares rotation between the hips, mid-back and shoulders. When the mid-back or hips are stiff, the lower back often picks up the slack.

Try open books before your round (8 slow reps each side), hip rotations, and Pilates work like side planks to build control through the trunk. Aim for rotation you can control, not just more range.

Pain lasting more than a couple of weeks, waking you at night, or travelling down an arm or leg with pins and needles is worth assessing first. Our clinical Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can build a program around your swing. Book online via the link in bio.
